content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

This post is about Solana payments for digital products, a solution that's been developed specifically to address the infrastructure problem faced by creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other platforms are unavailable or heavily restricted. By using Solana payments, creators can build a fully sovereign digital commerce stack that's not dependent on any third-party platform, allowing them to retain ownership and control over their business and data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, Solana payments for digital products relies on the integration of NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway, with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which provides the backend logic for order processing and automated delivery of digital products. This integration enables the creation of a custom payment flow that's not tied to traditional payment platforms, allowing creators to accept payments directly from their customers and deliver products instantly.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Solana payments for digital products provides a way to monetize digital creations without relying on traditional payment platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components that make Solana payments for digital products work together include NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. These components are integrated to create a seamless payment and delivery experience for customers, while giving creators full ownership and control over their business and data.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy Solana payments for digital products today, you'll need to follow these steps: acquire a Complete Builder Kit ($197) which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack; integrate NOWPayments with your chosen backend logic and file delivery service; configure your payment flow and automate delivery of digital products; and test your setup thoroughly to ensure a seamless experience for your customers.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question is, 'How much will I save by using Solana payments for digital products?' The answer is, you'll save up to 9.5% on every sale by avoiding Gumroad's 10% fee and using NOWPayments' 0.5% fee instead. For a product priced at $97, this translates to a savings of $921 per month, assuming 100 sales.
You can save up to 9.5% on every sale by using NOWPayments instead of Gumroad or Stripe.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy Solana payments for digital products today, follow these steps: acquire a Complete Builder Kit ($197); integrate NOWPayments with your chosen backend logic and file delivery service; configure your payment flow and automate delivery of digital products; test your setup thoroughly; and launch your sovereign digital commerce stack to start selling digital products without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between NOWPayments and Stripe?
NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee on every sale, while Stripe charges a variable fee ranging from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. This means you'll save up to 9.5% on every sale by using NOWPayments.
Can I use Solana payments for digital products with other payment gateways?
No, Solana payments for digital products is specifically designed to work with NOWPayments, and integrating it with other payment gateways may not provide the same level of sovereignty and control.
How do I automate delivery of digital products using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script?

You'll need to integrate Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script with NOWPayments and your chosen file delivery service to automate delivery of digital products. This involves configuring your payment flow and writing custom code to handle order processing and product delivery.
Can I use Solana payments for digital products to sell physical products?
No, Solana payments for digital products is designed specifically for digital products, and using it to sell physical products may not provide a seamless experience for customers.
What is the benefit of using a sovereign digital commerce stack?
Using a sovereign digital commerce stack gives you full ownership and control over your business and data, allowing you to make changes and upgrades without relying on third-party solutions.
Deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack today can save you $921 per month in fees.
